dict.string: Daily content: the overnight college cards at 2:30 AM, the day's content at 6 AM, a refresh at noon (founder, Sep 24 2026: seven runs a day was waste). Tracked Node runner owns each bounded stage and its process group, prioritizes Home output and card coverage, and records timestamped outcomes. Install only after the prior daily-insights run ends; never restart the active pick scheduler for content failures.

array.string: export PATH="/Users/adam.preda/.local/share/gary/runtimes/node-v22.23.2-darwin-arm64/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; cd /Users/adam.preda/Gary2.0/gary2.0 || exit $?; gary_phase=daily; [ "$(TZ=America/New_York date +%H)" -lt 6 ] && gary_phase=college-cards; gary_try=0; while :; do gary_try=$((gary_try+1)); gary_t0=$(date +%s); /Users/adam.preda/.local/share/gary/runtimes/node-v22.23.2-darwin-arm64/bin/node scripts/run-daily-content.js --phase "$gary_phase"; gary_rc=$?; gary_dt=$(( $(date +%s) - gary_t0 )); if [ "$gary_rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$gary_dt" -le 15 ] && [ "$gary_try" -lt 3 ]; then echo "daily content runner startup failed (rc=$gary_rc) — retry $gary_try/2" >&2; sleep 5; continue; fi; exit "$gary_rc"; done
